description: A T-6 Texan airframe painted silver/red as Northrop 8A-3P 'XXXI-93-I' (with 279 quoted as its serial by a 2023 photographer) mounted on a pylon in front of the Grupo Aéreo 8 headquarters; photographed August 2023. The 2023 photo shows T-6 canopy and cowling, so it is recorded as a T-6 in Northrop markings; true identity unknown. An 8A-3P look-alike marked XXXI-1 stood in the Las Palmas museum 2008-2014 and may be the same airframe.
